BiblicalUsage: Rahab is bluster — the proud, empty boast. Isaiah says of Egypt, 'their strength is to sit still'; Job says the proud helpers stoop under God; and again Job says God 'smiteth through the proud' when He divides the sea.
TheologicalSignificance: The lesson I take is that bluster is strength that talks: Egypt promised help and sat still, the proud helpers stooped, and God smote through the boasting.
